text: maya: Heads up — CI failed the docs build for one of the PRs, images 404 in the deploy preview even though local mkdocs serve shows them fine. Error snippet: "GET /docs/assets/img/rlhf-diagram.png 404" jon: Which PR? maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — it's the RLHF architecture diagram embed on the migration guide page. sasha: Could be frontmatter/baseUrl vs the mdx image loader. We flipped site_url/base in mkdocs last week for the /docs/ prefix. maya: Repro steps I used: ```mdx --- title: RLHF migration notes --- ![RLHF diagram](../assets/img/rlhf-diagram.png) ``` Build log shows a rewritten src to /assets/img/rlhf-diagram.png (no /docs/ prefix) which 404s on the preview host that serves pages under /docs/. docs-bot: Deploy preview failed for PR #1234 (1 missing static asset). kevin: I hit this earlier — quick workaround is to use absolute paths from the site root, e.g. `/docs/assets/img/rlhf-diagram.png`, or add a small frontmatter key `base: /docs/` per-page. But long-term we should make the mdx asset loader honor mkdocs' base path. jon: Right — there's also a srcset/resize plugin that emits hashed filenames and rewrites src. If that plugin assumes site root and mkdocs adds /docs prefix, you end up with duplicated or missing prefixes. sasha: I'll prepare a tiny fix: update the mdx-image-plugin to join baseUrl + emittedPath instead of assuming '/'. Also add a CI check to catch missing /docs/ prefixes. maya: If we change mkdocs config or plugin behavior, will that break existing permalinks? kevin: Should be low risk for static images. But good call to add a post-build scrub: fail CI if any starts with double-slash or doesn't start with "/docs/" when site base is /docs/. Example grep we can run: `grep -R " find largest HTML files for changed pages -> assert no 404 links for images (curl --head). Might be noisy but useful for migration window. sasha: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1237 — adjusts mdx-image-plugin, updates mkdocs config comment, and adds the CI grep. PTAL. maya: Thanks — testing the PR locally now. If CI and my local preview look good I'll merge. :thumbsup: kevin: Nice. After merge we should sweep other migration PRs for similar patterns (relative vs absolute image paths). jon: Agreed — maybe add a short doc snippet in CONTRIBUTING.md about preferred image paths during the migration to /docs/ base. sasha: Will add that to the PR as a small README note. maya: Verified — preview fixed for RLHF page. Merging after CI passes.
